name: teamshare
description: Shared team context for Claude Code: publish a short note, teammates see it at their next session start.

TEAMSHARE_URL.title: Server URL
TEAMSHARE_URL.description: The origin of your team's teamshare server, no path — e.g. http://localhost:8787 or https://teamshare.your-company.com.

TEAMSHARE_TOKEN.title: Your personal token
TEAMSHARE_TOKEN.description: The personal token your team lead sent you (it starts with tsm_). It identifies you specifically, so keep it private: anyone holding it can publish shares and record read receipts as you. If you don't have one, ask your lead to run: teamshare invite <your-email>
